_: The world's furniture at real-world sizes, in meters (w across its front, d deep, h tall), each with the range it was found in on the web and its sources. The single source: blender/scripts/build_meshy_props.py sizes each Meshy piece to it (each axis its own, so a desk is the right height whatever shape Meshy drew), tests/furniture.test.ts holds the finished models and the code's own constants to it, and docs/mobilya-olculeri.md is written from it (node blender/scripts/furniture_doc.mjs). `verified`: sources = the range comes from the pages listed; partly = no standard found, a common size.

people.note: Adults: median stature 1.755 m (men) and 1.626 m (women), 95th percentile 1.87 m and 1.74 m; seated eye height 0.75-0.80 m, popliteal height 0.39-0.43 m (5th-95th: 0.38-0.51 m). Our characters are 1.30-2.10 m (docs/karakterler.md); the lion lead 1.85 m, Mahmut 1.8 m.

range.door: A commercial door leaf is 0.91 x 2.13 m (36 x 84 in); the clear opening is at least 0.81 m wide and 2.03 m high (ADA). Our suite doorways are double doors, 2.0 m.
range.ceiling: Finished ceilings of Class A offices run 3.0-3.7 m (10-12 ft), floor to floor 3.75-4.3 m. Ours are ground-floor glass offices at 4.2 m, the tall end (taller ground floors are common; no source for the number).
range.meetingTable: A table for ten is 3.0-3.7 m (10-12 ft) by 1.2-1.5 m (48-58 in), 61-76 cm of edge a person, the room 0.9 m clear all round.

constants.note: The station's kit (world/station/kit.ts: TABLE_TOP, BENCH_TOP) has the desk and the bench seat, and a worker's seat anchor and laptop sit to them, so every desk and chair a worker uses matches them.

agac.range: Planted street tree, 2 in caliper: about 3-3.6 m (10-12 ft); mature 8 m and up. Tree pit: 1.35 m square typical (Sydney), 1.5 m preferred (Honolulu); the bed here is wider than a pit, a planter curb round it.

lamba.range: Pedestrian-scale lamps 3-5 m: 3.7-5.2 m with 15 ft acorn posts (Encinitas), 4.5-6 m on sidewalks (Global Street Design Guide).

bank.range: Seat 45-48 cm (18-19 in; 17.7 in on the Tor bench), 1.8 m for three, back 30-46 cm over the seat, seat depth 38-50 cm.

kafe-masasi.range: Bistro table 71-76 cm with 43-48 cm stools; a 9 ft (2.7 m) market umbrella stands 2.3-2.45 m (7.5-8 ft) overall.

kahve-tezgahi.range: Counter height 36-42 in (0.91-1.07 m): 1.05 m. The espresso machine on it brings it to 1.75 m. (No counter standard found: common practice.)

kahve-makinesi.range: Floor-standing drinks machines (vending cabinets) are about 1.8 m (72 in) tall. Countertop bean-to-cup units are only 0.44-0.6 m, so this is the floor kind. (No standard found: common practice.)

saksi.range: Commercial planter boxes run 0.6-1.8 m long (0.9-1.2 m most common) up to 3.0 x 1.07 x 1.2 m for the largest; 12-48 in high. This is a large one: box 55 cm, shrubs to 1.1 m.

ofis-masa.range: Fixed desk 71-76 cm (DIN: 74 +/- 2 cm); width 1.2-1.8 m, depth 0.6-0.76 m.

cicek-saksi.range: Large floor pot 60-75 cm across; 80 cm with flowers. (Common practice.)

ofis-sandalye.range: Task chair seat 43-53 cm (17-21 in), overall 0.95-1.09 m (37-43 in); 5th-percentile woman to 95th-percentile man need 38-51 cm.

yonetici-masa.range: Executive desk 1.5-1.8 m wide, 0.76-0.91 m deep, 71-76 cm high.

yonetici-koltuk.range: High-back executive chair: seat 45-55 cm, overall up to 1.25 m (49 in).

kanepe.range: Three-seater: 1.83-2.44 m long (2.1 m average), 0.81-1.0 m deep, 0.76-0.91 m high, seat 43-48 cm.

kitaplik.range: Office bookcase: 1.83 m (72 in, five shelves), 76-107 cm wide, 30-38 cm (12-15 in) deep.

toplanti-sandalye.range: Meeting chair: seat 43-53 cm, back to about 0.9 m.
